input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: streamline dossier interview flow with material carry-over

The dossier interview's "Start over" used to wipe the entire brief,
including any manuscript text the writer had already attached. Now
`initialMaterial` carries that text into the next interview so a
restart loses nothing already written — it seeds the "starting
material" field and is fed to the interviewer as context so follow-up
questions are oriented around what exists rather than a blank brief.

The inline Cancel/Close button on the refinery view is removed because
it duplicated the browser back button and the top bar's navigation.
With `onCancel$` gone, the component surface is simpler and the
parent routes control their own exit paths.

A shared `DossierTopBar` replaces the per-route header markup so
both create and refine show the same progress indicator and title.

Co-authored-by: Crush <crush@crush.local>
EOF
)"
